caption_txt.title: 189 Invitation Round: Who Got Invited? 🇦🇺📊
body: Last Thursday, 15 October, was the big 189 invitation round, and it was a very big round across many occupations. The two main groups invited were construction and healthcare. Registered nurses were invited from 70 to 80 points, and even offshore nurses received invitations on just 70 points. In construction there were a few surprises: cabinet makers on 75 points, carpenters on 65, wall and floor tilers, and even welders this time.

Professional occupations were invited too, such as economists on 65 points and medical laboratory scientists on just 80. In teaching, secondary school teachers were invited on 80 points, and early childhood teachers on 90 points. Want to see how your occupation compares to this round and previous rounds? Visit PFEC Melbourne and talk to our Registered Migration Agent Tushar Chopra (MARN 2418420).
